name: PR Files changed tab renders Smart Diff: groups, collapsed lock file, click genuinely expands it
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab (Smart Diff is now the default order) and confirm: the three role groups render (Core/Wiring/Boilerplate, uppercased by CSS text-transform — agent-browser matches innerText); package-lock.json is present but collapsed by design (a boilerplate file always starts collapsed — §6.2 rule 1); the split banner is absent (the seeded PR's 285 changed lines / 9 files sit under both too_big thresholds); and clicking the collapsed package-lock.json card genuinely expands it. Model-free: the flow never clicks the per-file ✨ Summarize pill, because deriving a real summary needs a model key and e2e runs without one (same rule 08-pr-intent.flow.json follows for 'Derive intent'). CORRECTED after a first review round: agent-browser's `get count`/`find nth` take a real CSS selector — there is NO `text=` engine on those subcommands (only the separate `find text <value>` locator uses text matching); a prior version of this flow used `text=...` for both absence checks and the badge disambiguation and every one of those three steps was silently vacuous (`get count "text=..."` always returns 0, `find nth N "text=..."` always errors). CORRECTED AGAIN after a second review round: the replacement's own final step — click src/config.ts's finding badge, then wait for `stripeSecretKey` — was itself unable to fail, because src/config.ts is `wiring` with a live finding, so §6.2 rule 2 starts it EXPANDED from first paint; the text was already on screen before any click, so the step passed whether or not the click did anything. Neither seeded boilerplate file (package-lock.json, README.md) carries a finding, so there is no badge on either to click — a badge-click assertion cannot be made non-vacuous against the current seed without changing it, which is out of this flow's scope. The step now instead clicks the collapsed package-lock.json card directly (a real, already-shipped interaction — FileCard's header `onClick={toggle}`, independent of the finding-badge mechanic) and re-runs the same structural div-count selector used to prove it starts collapsed, this time asserting it went from 1 to 2 — a genuine, click-caused reveal, not a load-time fact. Verified empirically against static HTML fixtures mirroring this page's real DOM shape (nesting, tag names, no class/id — the same convention this app's inline-styled components use), in both a correct-behaviour state (count flips 1→2 after the click) and a deliberately-broken one (click handler is a no-op; count stays at 1) — see task-9-report.md's fix-round section for the first round's fixture methodology and the final fix report for this round's two observed numbers. Every DOM fact a selector below relies on is cited to source: DiffTab.tsx wraps the tab in one <section>, not nested inside any other <section> (grepped repo-wide); GroupSection.tsx wraps each role group in its own <section style={s.group}>, itself only ever nested inside DiffTab's <section> when Smart Diff (not the flat viewer) is showing, and always renders exactly 3 direct <div> children in fixed order (heading, meta, list) before any files; FileCard.tsx's root renders exactly 1 direct child <div> (the header) when collapsed and 2 (header + body) when open, and its header is a <div onClick={toggle}> wrapping the filename <span>, so a click on the visible filename text bubbles to the same handler a real user click would; toast.tsx's toast container is the only OTHER role=status region on this whole app (grepped client/src) and is unconditionally mounted (empty, so present but with nothing to show) even with zero toasts, so `[role='status']` counts 1 at rest and 2 only when SplitBanner (the sole other role=status element, and the only one that's conditional) also renders. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — guaranteed by e2e-web.yml; run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md). NOTE: these selectors are empirically proven against fixtures that mirror the real markup exactly, not against the live app itself — the live run remains blocked by a pre-existing, out-of-scope Windows execFile bug in e2e/run.ts and (this session) a Docker outage; see task-9-report.md and the final fix report.

cmd: Add rate limiting to public API endpoints
steps.label: open the PR row
navigate to the PR detail route
switch to the Files changed tab
diff tab is active in the URL
Smart Diff (not the flat viewer) is the default order
the seeded lock file is present

the split banner is absent — only the always-mounted (empty) toast container carries role=status; a rendered SplitBanner would add a second one (too_big is false for the seeded PR: 285 lines / 9 files, both under threshold)

package-lock.json's diff body is NOT rendered: Boilerplate is the 3rd of 3 GroupSection <section>s (Core/Wiring/Boilerplate, present-only, always in that order); its list div is its 3rd direct <div>; package-lock.json (92+24=116 changed lines, 0 findings) sorts ahead of README.md (6+2=8 lines) as the list's 1st FileCard; a FileCard root has exactly 1 direct child <div> (the header) collapsed, 2 (header+body) open — this counts package-lock.json's own direct <div> children specifically, not a page-wide text search

click the collapsed package-lock.json card's header — FileCard's root <div onClick={toggle}> wraps the filename <span>, so clicking the visible filename text bubbles to the same toggle handler a real click on the row triggers; neither seeded boilerplate file carries a finding, so this is a plain collapse-toggle click, not a finding-badge click (see the flow's own description for why)

package-lock.json's FileCard now renders 2 direct child <div>s (header + body) instead of 1 — the SAME selector that proved it collapsed earlier in this flow, re-run after the click, now asserting the click genuinely expanded it rather than the file having been open all along
